postcards.message:
Hey!
I hope you're having fun in London. I wonder what you must be thinking about all the things you're seeing and trying. I hope it's not exhausting you too much, though.
I hope the weather is moody in the best way, that you got to try some authentic fish & chips, and that British people are real. Say hello to the Queen if you see her!

I had pancakes for breakfast today. They were not very good. Would not recommend. I wonder if you've had some authentic British fish 'n' chips yet. I have so much I want to ask you. It feels too much, so I guess I'm putting them here. It's strange to miss you more that you're in London, when the cadence hasn't changed much, but I do. I hope you have a good day.
